The Hideout hosts back-to-back Jam blocks every Sunday

All Jams are free to attend, just show up and sign in. Jams are held at The Hideout Annex — 5555 N. Lamar Blvd. B103

MONTHLY JAM SCHEDULE 11am-12:30pm 12:30-2pm 2-3:30pm
First Sunday Narrative Jam Shortform Jam BIPOC Jam
Second Sunday Singing Jam Shortform Jam Femme Jam
Third Sunday Neurodivergent Jam Shortform Jam Pride Jam
Fourth Sunday Singing Jam Shortform Jam
Fifth Sunday Shakespeare Jam Shortform Jam
